description: The three recorded windows for the comparison of the engine's Transforms with v1 (PLAN M2; docs/method/transforms.md). Months are v1's: a window runs from the first day of `from` to the last day of `to`. They are fixed here, not read from the data, so the comparison does not move when v1's data is refreshed.

windows.name: the whole of v1's axis as recorded on 2026-11-11
